title: Great plan!
text:
A very nice experience to learn a bit about the local culture. 
I recommend it to all those who want to bring a piece of Spain to their home country.  
The entire experience has been very easy and quite dynamic.
author: 979gretchenc

title: A highlight taste of Spain
text:
Fantastic experience in Barcelona.
The class was entertaining and authentic.
The team was friendly and with a very cozy atmosphere. Recommended for both locals and tourists.
author: gin_sh2021
